notes.title: Holomento: 🐀 Another sneak peek before v0.8 releases! 🐀
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/c80d8cae7d268459ea92a0ad81ca4caf063b6f42.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Hey everyone![/h1][p]We know it's been [i]quite[/i] a while since our last update, and we sincerely apologise for the silence on our part. But we hope to make up for it with [b]showcasing some more stunning screenshots! [/b](please see the [b][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/seanweech/holomento/posts/4473012"]Kickstarter post[/url] for GIFs[/b], upload sizes are my arch nemesis)[/p][p]In this little "Hey, we're still working on it!" post, we'll dive into some of the exciting progress we've made with [b]color grading, visual effects and weapons 🎨[/b] [/p][p]
Stay tuned for more, and as always, [b]we appreciate your feedback on our [url="http://discord.gg/FbaQ8zJ"]Community Discord[/url] or here in the comments![/b][/p][p](Active Discord members will probably already be familiar with most of the content featured in this post. Rest assured though that another update with even more new visuals will follow soon... maybe something about a new area to explore?)  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/f4a63df44000f944dabdd651cf9d156ca5a1b524.png"][/img][/p][h2]Everything shines in a new light[/h2][p]On top of our completely [b]overhauled lighting system[/b], we’ve [b]fine-tuned the color grading,[/b] giving each region its own distinct atmosphere, from the warm, sun-drenched landscapes to the cooler settings. [/p][p]
Every corner of the game now has its own unique feel, [b]making the world feel even more alive and dynamic. [/b] 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/2c8d7ebb87e4cdf31b6483f1edd0d4818fd1c1eb.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Guns, guns, and even more guns[/h2][p]As the title suggests, we're shaking things up with your gun arsenal!
Holomento now features a fully [b]revamped ammo reloading system,[/b] alongside a [b]legendary accessory[/b] that lets you fling your weapons away in style - because why not add a little flair to your firepower?  Additionally, your [b]Traveler class will now affect important aspects like reload speed and attack speed. [/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/bbf1414ce1819c31b3ecea117d66c98da34efa92.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And for [b]shotgun[/b] enthusiasts, we've [b]fine-tuned the damage calculation for the cone[/b], making every shot feel more accurate, more powerful, and way more satisfying![/p][p][/p][p]The [b]firework launcher[/b] has also been given some extra love, with [b]custom helixes for its projectiles[/b], a reload system just like any other weapon, and an ammo capacity boost with upgrades.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/b06e402330f168119a5ee66a6ade9777ebde2d35.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Booms, Blasts, and Brilliant Effects[/h2][p]And that's not all! We've also added some [b]stunning new VFX to bring that extra oomph to every moment.[/b] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/ac6ff7730214f1c9d430f387543528d711e1b10d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When explosions hit the water, get ready for incredibly satisfying [b]splash effects [/b]- as seen above. And if you hear a tree crashing to the ground, you may have just equipped our new [b]Woodcutter's Axe accessory[/b] - perfect for chopping down trees with [i]any[/i] weapon. [/p][p][/p][p]We've also introduced [b]footsteps and impact dust for the Traveler,[/b] so that each step leaves its own mark depending on the ground you're walking on, making every move feel even more immersive. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/c8b68d1e6d7931b15a56350ea5ed560fd535ae3d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]When's the update coming your way?[/h2][p]Sooo... this update didn't arrive at the beginning of this year [i](obviously)[/i] – BUT! [b]We're making lots of progress,[/b] and we'll be sure to let you know as we get closer to a definitive release date. Since we've made a lot of big changes to the game systems, we don't want to rush through things; right now, there's [b]a lot of older content to review to make sure everything's still working right[/b] 🪛 [/p][p]So yeah, since regular non-gamedev life also takes up a good chunk of our time, and you've now heard how much more than [i]just[/i] the initially planned QoL features we've packed into this patch [i](of course we would, you know us)[/i], it's still [b]not quite ready to be rolled out.[/b] [/p][p]We'll do our best to keep you in the loop and [b]will most likely share another progress post before the 0.8 release[/b] (which is btw now titled the [i]Journeys Update[/i]), so that you at least have some new Holomento content in the meantime. Also, check out the [url="https://trello.com/b/H2yIX1ZG/holomento-roadmap"]Holomento Roadmap[/url] to see how our current tasks are progressing! [/p][p][/p][p]As always, [b]thank you so much for your continued support and patience[/b] 🧡  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/f4a63df44000f944dabdd651cf9d156ca5a1b524.png"][/img][/p][h3][url="http://discord.gg/FbaQ8zJ"]Discord[/url] | [url="https://trello.com/b/H2yIX1ZG/holomento-roadmap"]Roadmap[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Holomento: 🐀 What we've been up to! 🐀
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/c80d8cae7d268459ea92a0ad81ca4caf063b6f42.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hey everyone![/h1]
[b]Let me start by saying this: The upcoming update has turned out to be way bigger than we first expected![/b] 💥

This means [b]it's going to take a bit longer to get everything right,[/b] as it's not just about fixing bugs or adding QOL tweaks anymore. But don't worry, it'll be worth the wait! We've got tons of great improvements in store and we can't wait for you to check them out. 
However, as you know, we're a pretty small team, so it might just take a little bit more time for us to get everything just right. We apologise for the delay and thank you for your patience.

[b]To make the wait a little sweeter, here's a sneak peek at what's coming in the next update:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/f4a63df44000f944dabdd651cf9d156ca5a1b524.png[/img]

[h2]We're changing resource gathering, ...[/h2]
Resource gathering in the game is undergoing some exciting changes. Instead of being placed in similarly sized piles, [b]resources will now be scattered throughout the Hollow,[/b] blending naturally into the environment for a more immersive experience.

You'll also find[b] destructible trees that can be felled[/b] with certain types of weapons, adding another new and dynamic element to the resource system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/7f3bc6a0ba96334ab57ee4225e927b380d90b7f6.png[/img]

[h2]... overhauling the user interface, ...[/h2]
We're excited to share that[b] a major UI overhaul is coming to Holomento.[/b]

The revamped design will offer [b]a more intuitive layout that simplifies navigation and optimises space.[/b] The new interface will match the overall style of the game, making it easier and more enjoyable than ever to explore your collections and track your progress. 

[h2]... improving the combat system, ...[/h2]
While playtesting various changes and fixes, we realised that [b]melee combat could use some extra love.[/b] That's why we've set out to fundamentally redesign the melee combat system. 

Expect new and improved mechanics for[b] parrying, blocking, and shield usage/breaking[/b] that will add a new dynamic to your encounters.  We're also adding [b]eye-catching new VFX[/b] to make combat look as juicy as it feels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/fa27f6dc4f27cf53fa1b5d81fb64883a453b99c1.png[/img]

[h2]... and upping the challenge![/h2]
While the headline might sound a bit daunting, don't worry - this is all about customisation. 
[b]These new options are there to give each run a unique feel,[/b] not just to make the game harder (unless you want them to, of course). With [b]region-specific weather effects and difficulty levels, various modifiers and dangerous curses,[/b] you can customise your travels and even seek out extra challenges to push your skills to the limit. All of these features are designed to keep the gameplay fresh and engaging, regardless of your experience level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/72cf2336c82016926c8244f5a7c6d6817572cd84.png[/img]

(No further screenshots in this part, as it would just be a bunch of boring spreadsheets and percentages that don't do justice to how [i]awesome [/i]this addition is going to be 📄✨)

[h2]So when will the new update arrive?[/h2]
We're gearing up for a big patch, and we're putting a lot of effort into improving the feel and progression of the game, as well as fixing bugs. And of course there's a lot more to this update than what I've just told you, like [b]a new reloading mechanic, ladders, rebalancing the health and damage of certain enemies, or adding more enemy camps[/b] (like the one in Frigid Fjord) to the different regions. 

All of this is coming together nicely, but there's still a lot of work to be done. [b]We're aiming for a [i]release at the beginning of next year,[/i] and we'll keep you posted on what we're working on in the meantime![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/b93450e275c3434a8708e1f8a15dff77714f024a.png[/img]

notes.title: Holomento - ❄️ Frigid Fjord Update ❄️ (Version 0.7.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/c80d8cae7d268459ea92a0ad81ca4caf063b6f42.jpg[/img]

Hail, Travelers!

Experience a completely re-imagined Holomento experience in (by far) our biggest update yet!
[list]
[*] Our most requested feature since Alpha... [b]Jumping[/b] is finally here!
[*] The [b]Frigid Fjord[/b] arrives as a brand new region featuring the upgrade-able town of Fjordhome!
[*] Eventide Pass has been reworked and vastly expanded with new mini-quests and more!
[*] Every region throughout the Hollow has been changed with new areas, chests, obelisks and more!
[*] Added an all new puzzle + platforming designed dungeon -  [b]The Ice Palace[/b]!
[*] A new plague-doctor inspired [b]Alchemist Class[/b] with a new signature throw-able bottle weapon type!
[*] [b]New Quests[/b] and a redesigned, more engaging and stylish [b]Dialogue System[/b]!
[*] [b]Redesigned Enemy AI[/b] with new attacks, movement, tracking and path-finding!
[*] Reworked mini-boss encounters and arenas!
[*] Multiple game-play system updates including keys and obelisks!
[*] A plethora of bug fixes, other features and lots, lots more!
[/list]
You can read the full patch notes below!

For more information on planned features coming in future patches, check out the [url=https://trello.com/b/H2yIX1ZG/holomento-roadmap]Holomento Roadmap[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/f4a63df44000f944dabdd651cf9d156ca5a1b524.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/247816fb55194bd27bf7a51454de9b7f9a017a39.png[/img][h3]Jumping[/h3]
Overwhelmingly our most requested feature since Holomento's Alpha over 3 years ago, we've finally added [b]jumping[/b] (and reworked and retouched most of the Hollow to compensate). We've added secrets and discoverables for you to find while exploring the world with this new traversal mechanic. The new Frigid Fjord and Ice Palace dungeon implement several puzzles and platforming challenges to maximize this new feature. We plan to add many more platforming and jumping puzzles to new and existing regions in future updates!

[h3]Overhauled Dialogue System[/h3]
The dialogue system has been completely reworked both visually and functionally with many new features including:
[list]
[*] [b]New Dialogue Text Visuals[/b] - Dialogue text is now much more colorful, dynamic and fully animated.
[*] [b]Updated Response System[/b] - Dialogue responses have been updated with a new style. NPCs can now talk for multiple textboxes worth of dialogue without the player needing to interrupt them.
[*] [b]Cinematic Cameras[/b] - The camera can now be dynamically moved during dialogue to highlight important locations, focus on the NPC, fade to black and more!
[*] [b]Audio Updates[/b] - Unique NPCs now have more distinct dialogue SFX! Other sounds are played during dialogue to improve immersion and better describe situations with audio cues.
[*] New NPCs - Added many new NPC's throughout the world including Donna Teilla, Ako, Voxifer, Sir Orion Starr, Xin' Coul, Cossar Pol and many others
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay System Updates[/h3]
Several systems throughout the game have been updated with new quality-of-life (QOL) features:
[list]
[*] [b]Reworked Class Unlock System[/b] - Classes are now unlocked by discovering a traveler class "memory" somewhere in the Hollow. A class unlock is surrounded by a low-floating pink mist and a skeleton donning the armor and items of the fallen traveler.
[*] [b]Updated Key System[/b] - Keys are no longer dropped upon a traveler's death. Keys are tied to the Holomento and follow the next traveler until they can find the door that they unlock. Keys have also been updated visually when picked up.
[*] [b]Updated Obelisks[/b] - Obelisks have been updated visually and are now located in pre-determined semi-permanent locations throughout the world.
[*] [b]Improved Signage[/b] - Signs have been added throughout the Hollow to help improve a traveler's sense of direction and relative location in the world
[*] [b]Elevators[/b] - New visuals, added dust bursts when arriving at destinations, fixed issues with pulling levers while elevators were already moving
[/list]
[h3]New Alchemist Class[/h3]
The [b]Alchemist Class[/b] is a plague-doctor-inspired class featuring a new thrown weapon type: Potion bombs!
[list]
[*] [b]Potion Bombs[/b] - These explosive jars are filled with a travelers favorite elemental chemical stew and explode upon impact dealing AOE damage to all nearby enemies. 
[*] [b]Alchemist Armor[/b] - Like every other Traveler class, the Alchemist brings a new set of armor with 5 upgrade levels for each piece.
[*] [b]Discovery[/b] - The Alchemist Class unlock can be found somewhere within one of the new region of the Eventide Hollow. 
[/list]
[h3]Frigid Fjord[/h3]
The [b]Frigid Fjord[/b] has been re-imagined as a brand new region with many features and areas including:
[list]
[*] [b]Fjordhome[/b] - This quaint fishing village on the far southwestern shores of the Hollow is home to penguins and tree-ent-like folks. Upgrading Fjordhome will reward travelers with stone and wood supplies as well as a bustling market with potions and items.
[*] [b]Frigid Fort[/b] - This large fortress sits atop the hills in the Southeast reaches of the Frigid Fjord. Conquering this fortress will enable travelers to journey more directly through the Frigid Fjord without having to pass through the Eventide Pass.
[*] [b]Frigid Ruins[/b] - This mini-boss arena sits at the far Northwest edge of the Fjord on the edge of the sea. Defeating the mini-boss here grants access to the central coastal region of the Hollow.
[*] [b]Ice Palace[/b] - The entrance to the Ice Palace lies in the southern region of the Frigid Fjord and can only be accessed after working cooperatively with the mysterious Cossar Pol.
[/list]
[h3]Ice Palace Dungeon[/h3]
The [b]Ice Palace Dungeon[/b] is the latest dungeon to sprout up in the Eventide Hollow. With a focus on platforming and puzzle elements, the Ice Dungeon sets itself apart from all others we've released so far. With two distinct paths forward and a focus on verticality, the Ice Palace presents itself as a monumental climb for any travelers brave enough to make the journey.
[h3]Enemy and Boss Updates[/h3]
[b][u]New Dungeon Boss - Jotu the Unseely King[/u][/b]
The Unseely Ice King lurks deep within the frozen spires of the Ice Palace. Wielding a menacing whip-sword combo, this large frosty foe showcases the new enemy AI attack system through several might whip and sword slashes.
[b][u]New Enemy Functions[/u][/b]
To improve engagement and combat dynamics, most enemies now have advanced functionality in their attack animations improving:
[list]
[*] [b]Player Tracking[/b] - enemies will now track a traveler more accurately during attack animations
[*] [b]Dynamic Attack Movement[/b] - enemies can now move towards, away, through and around a traveler during any attack animation
[*] [b]Telegraphed Attacks[/b] - most enemies now have improved attack telegraphing to better indicate when they will strike and what kind of attack it will be.
[*] [b]Variable Animation Speed[/b] - attacks now have adjusted attack animation speed based on the size and tier of the enemy.
[/list]
[b][u]New Enemy Attacks[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Sword & Shield enemy variants now have "gap closers", dynamic shield blocking, ranged attacks and "gap increasers"
[*] Twinsword enemy variants now have strafing, sidestep dodges (side flips), "gap closers", "gap increasers" and dash attacks
[*] Spear enemy variants now have AOE "gap closers", "gap increasers" and ranged "hitscan" attacks
[*] Greatsword enemy variants now have "gap-closing combos", ranged attacks, ranged attack deflection and AOE "gap closers"
[/list]
[b][u]New Enemies[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Sword & Shield Armored Skele[/b] - A new Tier 2 Skele that's more powerful than a regular Sword & Shield Skele but not quite as strong as Dark Knights wielding Swords & Shields
[*] [b]Twinsword Armored Skele[/b] - A new Tier 2 Skele that's more powerful than a regular Twinsword Skele but not quite as strong as Dark Knights wielding Twinswords
[*] [b]Spear Armored Skele[/b] - A new Tier 2 Skele that's more powerful than a regular Spear Skele but not quite as strong as Dark Knights wielding Spears
[*] [b]Greatsword Armored Skele[/b] - A new Tier 2 Skele that's more powerful than a regular Greatsword Skele but not quite as strong as Dark Knights wielding Greatswords
[/list]
[b][u]Overhauled Many Existing Enemies[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Necromancer Skeles
[*] Sword & Shield Skele
[*] Twinsword Skele
[*] Spear Skele
[*] Greatsword Skele
[*] Archer Skele
[*] Sword+Shield Dark Knight
[*] Twinsword Dark Knight
[*] Spear Dark Knight
[*] Drake Hunter
[*] Wolves
[*] Giant Skele
[*] Armored Wyrm
[*] Watcher Beetle
[*] Scorpic Stone
[*] Hornets
[*] Plant Spitters
[*] Plant Roots
[/list]
[b][u]Reworked Minibosses[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Cha Demon[/b] - The Cha Demon has received a new look, animations and attack patterns. The Demon is much more aggressive and leaves few openings for attack.
[*] [b]Royal Knights[/b] - Royal Knights are now mini-bosses that share many characteristics and attack patterns as their less powerful Dark Knight counterparts.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/25bb0acf229353b32cf98d091a57849c5c066dc0.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Updated fall damage system to be "total distance fallen" based instead of velocity based. Scaled fall damage with a curve with key heights based on several locations throughout the Hollow.
[*] The fall damage curve is applied as follows: 12m: 0%, 18m: 25%, 24m: 50%, 32m: 85%, 36m: 95%, 40m: 100%
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/73f16ab6806f2d5474d02fd821926458d241a6c0.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Consolidated materials for static meshes throughout several regions
[*] Added new material functions to smoothly and efficiently blend between different static meshes
[*] Fixed several performance issues found in the enemy AI logic
[*] Fixed performance issues in Eventide Pass caused by bad pathfinding routes
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/e98561e394c14b4612187bef5cd47140a53c4a2a.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed dialogue issues for most regions including Autumn Forest, Central Valley, Dragon Bone Desert, East Valley, Eventide Pass, Frigid Fjord, Lush Valley and Tori Jin Temple.
[*] Fixed several bugs with the Evenfall questline to ensure it works properly and upgrades correctly
[*] Fixed Artimus Museum / Evenfall dialogue
[*] Fixed upper Guild NPCs: Added dialogue, passive dialogue and updated static meshes
[*] Fixed Geist, Estrela and Boone dialogue
[*] Finished Toukie's dialogue in several locations

[*] Fixed a bug where falling from ragdoll height into water would make you ragdoll and break fly high into the air

[*] Fixed a bug where the guild upgrades wouldn't properly work
[*] Fixed a bug when you attack Skeleton Archers with the bow before they aggro (very long range) and kill them, they sometimes do not despawn but lose their head, keep attacking you and become untargetable (their collider stays) EDIT: Happened with the ice cannons as well
[*] Fixed a bug where reloading (and respawning) either completely despawns enemies if they had aggro on you before (always) or, if not, removes their collider and aggro zone (sometimes, happens more often with melee enemies?) until you run through/past them (might be related to your "respawning properly reset enemy spawners" issue)

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/c80d8cae7d268459ea92a0ad81ca4caf063b6f42.jpg[/img]

Hail, Travelers!

Abdominals abound in this rework of Eventide Hollow's central valley region in Holomento Early Access 0.6.3 - The Evenfall Update!

[*] UI updates
[*] And lots more blood, sweat, and tears!
[/list]

notes.title: Holomento - 🍂Autumn Islands Update🍂 (Version 0.6.2)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/c80d8cae7d268459ea92a0ad81ca4caf063b6f42.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello Travelers![/b]

Today I'm happy to share Holomento Early Access 0.6.2 -🍂Autumn Islands Update🍂!

This update features lots of new gameplay elements and areas including:
[list]
[*] An expanded Autumn Forest and Eventide Pass Region
[*] 4 new enemies and 1 new miniboss
[*] The Autumn Islands Dungeon
[*] The Watcher Dungeon Boss
[*] New puzzle mechanics and puzzles throughout the overworld
[*] Grindrails
[*] UI updates
[*] And lots more!
[/list]

[b]Check out the new trailer right here:[/b]
[previewyoutube=TkDZpchD7q0;full][/previewyoutube]

You can read the full patch notes below!

For more information on planned features coming in future patches, check out the [url=https://trello.com/b/H2yIX1ZG/holomento-roadmap]Holomento Roadmap[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/f4a63df44000f944dabdd651cf9d156ca5a1b524.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/247816fb55194bd27bf7a51454de9b7f9a017a39.png[/img][h3]Expanded Autumn Forest, Eventide Pass and other Regions[/h3]
[b]Eventide Pass Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new alternate journey route from the Eventide Pass through the Autumn Forest to reach the Central Valley
[*] Added a new miniboss arena to the alternate route from Eventide Pass to the Autumn Forest
[*] Added new shortcuts, chests, vases, hives and enemies to the Eventide Pass
[*] Updated camera collisions on the Eventide Pass Bridge to make railings less frustrating
[*] Added new puzzles to the Eventide Pass (including a guaranteed golden chest reward)
[/list]
[b]Autumn Forest Expansions and Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Expanded the Autumn Region to the south and added the "Autumn Wilds" region
[*] Added several puzzles and item unlocks to the Autumn forest
[*] Updated Autumn Forest enemy spawns with new spawning pools including several new enemy types
[*] Updated Autumn Forest enemy drops
[*] Added new elevator shortcut between the Autumn Forest and Autumn Wilds
[*] Added new cave featuring numerous enemy spawns and loot in the Autumn  Wilds
[*] Added the Autumn Islands in the distance to all overworld regions
[*] Updated river meshes and lake depth in the Autumn Forest
[*] Added several new shortcuts to the Autumn Wilds
[*] Added grindrails to the Autumn Region
[/list]
[b]Other Region Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added unlockable grindrails to the desert for quicker traversal across the large region
[*] Added a lighthouse and puzzle to the Central Valley
[*] Added several projectile launcher puzzles throughout the overworld
[/list]
[h3]The Autumn Islands - Holomento's 3rd Dungeon[/h3]
Added the Autumn Islands Dungeon featuring 10 unique puzzles and 3 alternate routes to experience them each
[list]
[*] Added starting islands with introductions to new puzzle mechanics
[*] Added 10 dungeon islands and puzzles
[*] Added new puzzle mechanics including projectile launcher, redirectors, flip-flop platforms, grindrails and more!
[*] Added The Watcher's Domain island
[*] Added The Autumn Islands Dungeon Completion mark for all classes
[*] Added the Autumn Islands Dungeon Gem (Eternal Gem) and it's passive that grants all follower 50% increased damage
[/list]
[h3]The Watcher - Holomento's 3rd Dungeon Boss[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added The Watcher
[*] The Watcher summons its Watcher Beetles throughout the battle and increases the summon rate as the battle carries on
[*] Damaging Watcher Beetles also damages the Watcher
[*] The Watcher is an aggressive foes that will try to melee the Traveler throughout the battle
[*] A good strategy to defeat this foe is keeping distance and focusing Watcher Beetles as he continues to summon them
[/list]
[h3]New Items, Abilities and Passives[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added several new overworld puzzles for unlocking new items
[*] Added the "Dark Wizard Hat" - a L5 Wanderer Hood alternative
[*] Added the "Cloaked Knight Helm" - a L5 Knight Helm/Wanderer Hood alternative
[*] Added "The Colt" - A revolver that has the "Demon's Bane" passive that instantly kills any demon enemies/minibosses
[*] Added the "Witch's Broom" - An accessory that increase movement speed
[*] Add follower items - a new class of accessory that gives the Traveler followers that passively attack foes / give the Traveler other benefits
[*] Added the "Watcher Beetle" - A follower item that gives the Traveler a follower beetle that passively fires projectiles at nearby enemies 
[*] Added the "Watcher's Big Beetle" - A boss follower item that gives the Traveler a large follower beetle that passively fires projectile bursts at nearby enemies 
[*] Added the "Eternal Gem" - The dungeon gem which grants a passive that increases follower damage by 50%
[/list]
[h3]Enemy Armor System[/h3]
Some enemies now have an armor stat that reflects projectiles and reduces ranged damage taken.
[list]
[*] This stat is shown on enemy healthbars denoted by a shield with the amount of armor indicated (this number is the % of damage reduced from ranged attacks)
[*] The distance projectiles are deflected is tied directly to the amount of armor an enemy has
[*] Armored enemies are more rare and typically more difficult than regular enemies
[/list]
[h3]Grindrails[/h3]
Added grindrails that allow quick traversal through large areas
[list]
[*] Added a grindrail "minigame" where xp can be earned while riding the rail
[*] Grindrails can be activated using buttons, levers and switches
[*] Grindrails can act as shortcuts or may sometimes be the only option to reach high-up or far-off locations (such as in the Autumn Islands dungeon)
[/list]
[h3]Projectile Launchers and Redirectors[/h3]
Added projectile launchers and redirectors - new puzzle elements that can be used to open doors, activate grindrails, open shortcuts and more!
[list]
[*] Redirectors are used to redirect projectiles from launchers (or in some cases Traveler projectiles) in a different direction
[*] Projectile launchers fire projectiles that can be used to activate doors, grindrails, moving platforms/blocks and other interactables
[*] Projectile launcher projectiles will always redirect when hitting redirectors
[*] Some projectile launchers can be controlled and rotated, use this to take aim at redirectors and projectile activators!
[*] 
[/list]
[h3]Magic Barriers[/h3]
Added magic barriers that act as dungeon doors both inside the Autumn Islands Dungeon and out.
[list]
[*] These barriers can be activated/deactivated using buttons, levers and switches
[*] These barriers block projectiles and travelers
[/list]
[h3]Boss Camps[/h3]
Added Boss Camps that act as fast-travel target/respawn points in-front of Dungeon Boss doors.
[list]
[*] Travelers will always walk-through these camps and unlock them before fighting the dungeon boss
[*] If a traveler dies during the dungeon boss they can now always choose to respawn right before the fight starts.
[*] Boss Camps can be fast-traveled to but not from.
[*] Added "The Watcher's Domain" Boss Camp
[*] Added "Cerenobia's Ruins" Boss Camp
[*] Added "The Rat King's Arena" Boss Camp
[/list]
[h3]New Enemies[/h3]
Added 3 Autumn Regional enemies
[list]
[*] Added "Leaf Warriors" - These leafy knights are quick dastards that will charge up close to attack Travelers with their large battle axes and shields
[*] Added "Watcher Beetles" - These small beetles are minions of the Watcher that will take aim at Travelers from a distance. These beetles have a keen eye and will predict a Travelers movement, so be careful of moving in the same direction while fighting them!
[*] Added "Armored Wyrms" - These fierce armored beasts deal heavy damage and deflect projectiles with their heavy armor with 70% damage reduction. Aim for their eye to deal critical damage and fell them quickly!
[/list]
Added the "Royal Guard" knight variant
[list]
[*] These Legendary enemies can be found on the alternate route from the Eventide Pass to the Autumn Forest and Wilds.
[*] Royal Guards are quick and deal massive damage
[*] Royal Guards have heavy armor and large shields so ranged attacks are mostly ineffective
[*] If a Traveler doesn't have lots of gear, it may be wise to run from these terrifying foes!
[/list]
New Miniboss - Autumn Bones
[list]
[*] A new variant of the "Giant Bones" class of enemies, these large skeletons can be found in Autumn miniboss arenas
[/list]
[h3]UI Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] - Updated enemy healthbars to better differentiate between enemy difficulties (Levels 1-5) with new borders, healthbar gradients and skulls
[*] Updated enemy healthbar animations for appearing and defeating enemies
[*] Updated notes and keys to a world-space summary
[*] Notes and keys now display their information before being picked up
[*] Updated signs to a world-space view
[*] Updated item cards for item pickups to be world-space
[*] Added animations for item cards
[*] Added animations for interaction prompts
[*] Fixed several interaction prompt UI bugs
[/list]
Updated to world-space interaction prompt UI for the following interactions:
[list]
[*] Signs
[*] Vases
[*] Resource Piles
[*] Chests
[*] Obelisks
[*] Doors
[*] Levers
[*] Mining
[*] Contract Boards
[*] Relics
[*] Museum Relic Viewing
[*] Fishing
[*] Keys
[*] Collectible Notes
[*] Hives
[*] Dungeon Gems
[/list]
[h3]Music[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated the Autumn Forest Track
[*] Added the Autumn Islands Dungeon Track
[*] Added the Watcher Boss Track
[/list]
[h3]Other Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Smoothed visual transitions for items being picked up and dropped
[*] Added a gold chest behind the coliseum
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/25bb0acf229353b32cf98d091a57849c5c066dc0.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Updated critical hit boxes for most enemies
[*] Added 25% armor for all knight enemies
[*] Added 50% armor for Royal Knights

[*] Added 10% armor to Knight minibosses
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/e98561e394c14b4612187bef5cd47140a53c4a2a.png[/img]

[*] Fixed a bug where the aim reticle would play it's fadeout animation even when the reticle was already hidden

notes.title: Holomento - 🌴Lost City Update🌴 (Version 0.6.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/c80d8cae7d268459ea92a0ad81ca4caf063b6f42.jpg[/img]

Hello travelers!

Today I'm excited to share Holomento's second major update (0.6.0) with all of you! It's much larger than the last! The 🌴Lost City Update🌴 is here and features two new core game mechanics, a new Dungeon featuring a new Boss and puzzles, new Enemies and an overhauled Dragon Bone Desert!

[b]We're extremely excited to get this new update out to everyone![/b] We'd like to especially thank our community Discord for their support in providing us feedback on bugs and feature requests. If you haven't already, you can join the [url=http://discord.gg/FbaQ8zJ]Holomento Discord[/url] to share your feedback and suggestions!

Here's a short teaser showing off what you can expect in the new update:

[previewyoutube=8_M6mtoqX1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

But that's not all! We've more exciting news to share!

[b]First of all, you can get Holomento for 20% off right now![/b] This is the perfect time to dive into the game and all of the new content the Lost City Update has to offer!

[b]Also, the official Holomento OST Vol. 1 and Vol. 2 by our amazing composer Adeel Jafree is available on Steam now![/b] Get it now with a [b]15% launch discount[/b] and listen to the amazing tunes of Holomento whenever you like! The OST will also get expanded alongside major updates for the game, so make sure to keep an eye on that!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1976990/Holomento_Soundtrack

[h3]So what's next?[/h3]
With two major updates released this summer, we are going to be working on some quality-of-life updates and patches over the next few weeks before diving into the next major update. 

With that said, our next major update target will be the Autumn Update releasing this October. This update will feature a reworked Autumn Forest region, a new Autumn-Themed Dungeon and a special Halloween limited-time event!

For more information on planned features coming in future patches, check out the [url=https://trello.com/b/H2yIX1ZG/holomento-roadmap]Holomento Roadmap[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/f4a63df44000f944dabdd651cf9d156ca5a1b524.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/247816fb55194bd27bf7a51454de9b7f9a017a39.png[/img]
[h3]Dragon Bone Desert Overhaul[/h3]
The sands of the Dragon Bone Desert have shifted!

The Dragon Bone Desert has greatly increased in size and now features several new unique locations. The desert has also received new puzzles, chests, enemies, contract boards, shops and an overhauled town.
[list]
[*] Overhauled the Desert City and renamed it to the Dragon Bone Resort
[*] The Dragon Bone Resort contains lots of secret chests, vases and obelisks as well as a market with a town's typical amenities
[*] In the future, the Dragon Bone Resort Pyramid will feature some exciting new content as well as more NPCs and quests throughout so stay tuned!
[*] Added several puzzles to the Dragon Bone Desert featuring elements from the Lost City dungeon
[*] Added 5 new sub-regions to the Desert
[*] Added the Dragon Valley sub-region
[list]
[*] This deep pit contains a maze of trails and hanging wooden bridges that could prove useful to travelers wishing to cut quickly across the desert
[/list][*] Added the Lakefront Fort sub-region
[list]
[*] The Lake, Dam and Fort contain secrets and shortcuts for travelers that wish to open alternate routes for future journeys
[/list][*] Added the Lost City Outskirts sub-region
[list]
[*] These outskirt ruins feature fearsome creatures ready to pounce on unsuspecting travelers that wander towards the lost city.
[*] Several puzzles in this region provide travelers an opportunity to gather valuable rewards if completed
[/list][*] Added the Maze of the Lost sub-region
[list]
[*] The deep Maze in the northern corner of the Dragonbone Desert contains several puzzles and treasures for those brave enough to navigate it
[/list][*] Added the Dragon Bone Resort Beach sub-region
[list]
[*] This pleasant beach on the outskirts of the Dragon Bone Resort is a popular fishing and swimming spot for the few tourists making visits from outside the Hollow.
[/list]
[/list]
[h3]Lost City Dungeon[/h3]
A great city has risen from the deep sands of the Dragon Bone Desert...

The Lost City Dungeon has arrived and features new puzzles and puzzle elements, a new boss fight, new dungeon shops, the 2nd dungeon gem and more!
[list]
[*] The towering Lost City is now visible from most regions of the Eventide Hollow improving sense of direction and navigation to reach the dungeon (and desert)
[*] Added the 9-room puzzle section of the dungeon where travelers will need to navigate through water puzzles, spikes, moving platforms and more!
[*] 4 of the 9 rooms feature procedural puzzles while the other 5 feature puzzles that remain static between journeys
[*] Added a water level puzzle that integrates all 9 rooms of the dungeon. The water is controlled by pressure plates found throughout puzzle rooms.
[*] Added spikes that can be controlled by switches, levers, lanterns and more!
[*] Added new timed Lost City door puzzles that will require quick feet to navigate!
[*] Added moving platforms that can be controlled with pressure switches
[*] Added static regions to the desert featuring new enemies and treasures
[*] Added a new upgradeable Lost City shop
[*] Added a maze boss arena phase for the Lost City
[*] Added a new Lost City arena for Cerenobia
[/list]

[h3]Cerenobia - The King of Lost Gold[/h3]
A fearsome new boss guards the Perfection Gem of the Lost City - introducing Cerenobia the King of Lost Gold
[list]
[*] Added "Cerenobia's Lance" a new boss item that is earned by defeating Cerenobia
[*] Added Cerenobia Phase 1 - Escape from Cerenobia during the maze chase portion of the battle to reach the safe area before defeating him in Phase 2+3
[*] Added Cerenobia Phase 2 - Battle the armor-hardened Cerenobia during Phase 2 in the Lost City Arena
[*] Added Cerenobia Phase 3 - Complete the Lost City Arena puzzle to break Cerenobia's armor off and reveal the final showdown of the fight!
[/list]

[h3]Swimming[/h3]
Time to take a dip in the waters of Eventide!

To swim, simply wade (or fall) into any deep body of water and you'll float right to the surface. You can swim faster in the water by using the sprint button! Be careful though as while you're in the water you can't attack enemies or do any damage. Whenever you want to get out of the water simply swim to a shallow area or up a ramp/stairs.
[b]Full Swimming Feature List[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated all water bodies throughout the Hollow visually and to allow for swimming!
[*] Wade into any water body to automatically start swimming
[*] Use the sprint button to swim faster while swimming
[*] Enemies can't swim but can still fire ranged attacks at you while you're in the water so watch out!
[*] Water bodies are used during puzzles throughout the new Lost City dungeon so remember that you will always float to the top of water and use that to your advantage!
[/list]
[h3]Fishing[/h3]
Ready your reels because the Hollow's fishing season is open! 

To fish, simply walk up to a body of water until a fishing prompt appears. You can then cast your line and wait for your first bite! Once a fish is on the hook, you'll need to reel it in by completing a hook-tracking minigame. Once you've caught your fish, it's records will be added to your save file and the fish will be automatically sold for profit and added to the new Museum Aquarium!

[b]Full Fishing Feature List[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a new fishing system 
[*] Added fishing minigame to reel in fish
[*] Once caught, fish size records are automatically stored and fish are sold for immediate profit
[*] Fish data and records are persistent for all travelers between journeys
[*] Added a Fish Compendium tab to the Collections section of the tab menu
[*] Added an Aquarium to the Museum where caught fish are automatically donated
[*] Added new fishing regions to all bodies of water (rivers, lakes, oceans, etc.)
[*] Added 13 initial fish types with unique sizes and locations to be caught
[*] Added "No Fishing" regions where some bodies of water don't support fishing. If a prompt doesn't appear, you won't be able to fish in that region!
[*] Added new SFX for all fishing interactions (casting, reeling, fish landed, nibbles, bites and victory/failure tunes)
[/list]

[h3]Other Additions[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hornets are tormenting inhabitants of the Dragon Bone Desert! These aggressive foes are strong combatants on both the ground and in the air! Take them out quickly before they can sting!
[*] Bee hives have been spotted throughout the Hollow! Honey (and money) can be extracted from them but will anger the bees nested inside! Be prepared to run or fight if you harvest their honey!
[*] Flower fields filled with butterflies have been spotted growing throughout the Hollow! It's rumored these fields contain high concentrations of bee hives!
[*] Added new resource piles throughout the Lost City and Desert
[*] Journey's End light beam now scales with distance from the Traveler
[*] Added the "Experimental Treatment" accessory

[*] Added a damage border to indicate when the Traveler takes damage
[*] Added SFX when interacting with signs
[*] Added SFX when adding resources to the stockpile
[*] Added SFX for book page turning
[*] Added SFX for picking up the "mysterious book"
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/25bb0acf229353b32cf98d091a57849c5c066dc0.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Added passives for both existing Dungeon Gems once they are collected during a journey
[list]
[*] The Energy Gem now increases movement speed by 25%
[*] The Perfection Gem now increases wealth collected by 50%
[/list][*] Increased potions gained from potion chests to +5
[*] Adjusted all banner ability cooldowns to 15 seconds
[*] Adjusted the prayer ability cooldown to 30 seconds
[*] Buffed starting and scaling stats for the Wanderer class
[*] Increased bow damage scaling at max draw by 210%
[*] Changed bow draw scaling to quadratic from linear
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/e98561e394c14b4612187bef5cd47140a53c4a2a.png[/img]

Hello travelers!

The additions and improvements introduced in this update were thanks to your amazing support and feedback, especially on our Community Discord! Thank you so much everyone!

Here's a short teaser showing off some of the changes to how combat works:

[previewyoutube=RisPL2ZZVtM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]So what's next?[/h3]
Now that the game is in a much more polished state, we're hard at work preparing the first major content update - The Summer Desert Update - for everyone! Stay tuned for more information on that!

In any case, we hope you give this new major update a try! In any case, you can read the full patch notes below (grab a coffee or two, maybe - it's a lot)!

[h3]New Stats System[/h3]
Complete rework of all traveler stats and items. Combat stats are now split into two seperate categories: melee and ranged while several new stats have also been added/changed.

Melee and Ranged Stats
[list]
[*] Attack Speed
[*] Damage
[*] Range
[*] Knockback
[*] Stun
[/list]
Other Stats
[list]
[*] HP
[*] HP Regen
[*] Movement Speed
[*] Accuracy
[*] Luck
[/list]

[list]
[*] Updated shotgun spread to a cone based calculation and split into 20 shell fragments instead of 5. Shotguns have a guaranteed pellet at the reticle center.
[*] Updated stats in item boxes
[*] Updated stats in the class selection screen
[*] Updated stats throughout the primary UI
[*] Updated stats for the "Q" menu
[*] Updated stats in tab menu
[*] Added a middle section between item boxes for item swaps that shows the changes in your stats (50% alpha no change, green for increase and red for decrease)
[*] Updated Shop Item Icons
[*] Updated stats in shops
[*] Added tooltips for stat icons
[*] Updated enemy scaling to be dependent on new stats
[*] Updated stats in class selection
[*] Updated accuracy for hitscan weapons
[*] Added new stat icons including HP regen, accuracy, luck and more
[/list]
[h4]The Luck Stat[/h4]
Among the new stats added is a new luck stat. Luck influence most chance-based rolls in the game and is also factored into several calculations throughout Holomento.
[list]
[*] Implemented luck stat into item rolls and crit chances
[*] Cassandra the fortune teller now changes your luck stat temporarily by a random amount (-3, -2, -1, 0, +1, +2, +3). Price per reading reduced to $100.
[/list]

[*] Added control for rotation while player is melee attacking
[*] When snapping to enemies, the player can now influence which enemy to snap to based on control rotation and active input.
[*] Added a new combo indicator to make attack combo timing more obvious
[*] When not attacking with a melee attack or in active combat, the combo indicator slowly fades out
[*] Non perfect combo inputs now do reduced damage
[*] Updated spear/poleaxe melee combo animations
[*] Updated spear/poleaxe ranged attack animation
[*] Updated spear/poleaxe weapon visuals
[*] Fixed melee snapping distance and changed it to be based on individual attack animations
[*] Traveler shields now passively reflect projectiles
[*] Separated melee and ranged attack speed
[*] Updated melee combo visuals
[*] Added Melee Attack Range. This stat influences the hitbox with which a traveler will damage enemies.
[*] Added melee and ranged stun system. Upon getting hit, enemies will briefly become stunned based on the relevant player stats.
[*] Added melee and ranged knockback system. Upon getting hit, enemies will get knocked back based on relevant player stats.
[*] Updated enemy poleaxe and spear attacks
[*] Added dart projectiles (used with Magic Rifles)
[*] Updated Malurian Sigil beam visuals
[/list]
[h3]New Weapons and Accessories[/h3]

[*] Added the "ZAP!" passive that arcs lightning to nearby enemies when they take damage from the player
[*] Updated visuals for Levels 3-5 of the Malurian Weapon line
[*] Updated weapon pickups to make them more visible (added rotation and offsets based on weapon size to prevent ground clipping)
[/list]
[h3]New Aiming Reticles and Animations[/h3]

[*] Magic Reticle with projectile drop indicators
[*] Blade Reticles

[*] Updated swinging axe SFX

[*] Added SFX to Rat King death animation

notes.title: 🐀 HOLOMENTO IS OUT NOW IN EARLY ACCESS 🐀
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Everyone![/h2]
[b]Before we start this update, have a trailer![/b]

[previewyoutube=fU_PgIIFLdg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]That's right! Early Access starts right now![/b]

The Early Access release comes with a lot of new content and marks [b]a huge step[/b] for the development of Holomento! This includes the new item and class unlock system, completely new enemies and bosses and, of course, the very first dungeon: [b]Evenfall Cistern[/b]!
Explore this new dungeon and master its challenges to fight the completely re-done [b]Rat King boss[/b] fight.

With the Early Access release also comes the ability to [b]start rebuilding Eventide Hollow[/b]! Collect different kinds of resources in the overworld or in Evenfall Cistern to upgrade the shops and slowly [b]bring back life to this cursed land[/b]. Upgraded shops will give you many benefits for future runs, like better and stronger items or cheaper prices!

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
Unfortunately due to the nature of the game and it's sheer size, there's still a few outstanding issues we could not 100% iron out before the Early Access release. We're hard at work at providing hotfixes for most if not all of these issues during the next few days and weeks. To get a live overview on the state on these issues (and the overall roadmap and progress on the game) you can refer to [b]our public Trello board[/b] at any time and check in on the project's status!
You can check it out here anytime you like: [url=https://trello.com/b/H2yIX1ZG/holomento-roadmap]https://trello.com/b/H2yIX1ZG/holomento-roadmap[/url]

If you notice any bugs that are not in this list or would like to give general feedback and/or reports, we recommend to [b]join our Discord[/b] server right here: [url=http://discord.gg/FbaQ8zJ]http://discord.gg/FbaQ8zJ[/url]
We'll share our progress and answer any questions as best we can in real-time! Of course we'll also continue to post more substantial updates on Kickstarter as well! 😄

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
[b]Bugfixing. Mostly![/b] At least for the next weeks we will focus on ironing out the remaining bugs and polishing the game. After that we will continue working on new content! Now that all systems are in place and (mostly) working, we're looking forward to concentrate on bringing many more dungeons, items and bosses to the game at a faster pace!
You can again refer to the public Trello board: [url=https://trello.com/b/H2yIX1ZG/holomento-roadmap]https://trello.com/b/H2yIX1ZG/holomento-roadmap[/url] [b]to check our Roadmap at any time[/b] and see what's in store for the game during all of Early Access.

We're incredibly happy that we're finally able to share the world of Holomento with you. 💖

notes.title: Holomento Alpha 0.4.60
notes.content:
Hello travelers!

Today I'm excited to share Holomento Alpha 0.4.60!

This is Holomento's biggest update yet and adds loads of content in preparation for our upcoming Early Access Release. Here are a few highlights:
[list]
[*] New resources system to enable building and shop upgrades throughout the world.
[*] New contract system providing an unlimited amount of contracts (quests) for a traveler to complete.
[*] Updated shop system with upgrades utilizing resources. Shop upgrades include better prices, sales and more inventory space!
[*] New museum featuring a full questline with the redesigned Museum curator Artimus! Features a new area, collectibles throughout the world and the museum points and ribbon system!
[*] New banking system to incentivize depositing and saving money. Money is now dropped on death and the only way to keep it safe is in the bank!
[/list]

You can read the full patch notes below!

For more information on planned features coming in future patches, check out the [url=https://trello.com/b/H2yIX1ZG/holomento-roadmap]Holomento Roadmap[/url]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/1b743a9588926a8b1e329f63cba12d6b7735a0af.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/f4a63df44000f944dabdd651cf9d156ca5a1b524.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/247816fb55194bd27bf7a51454de9b7f9a017a39.png[/img][h3]Contract System[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the infinite contract system. Contracts are small goal quests that a traveler must accept at a town's contract board. 
[*] Once accepted, contracts must be completed before more contracts can be accepted.
[*] Contracts are randomized and will always reward a traveler with money. 
[*] Contracts can also reward the traveler with items and potions
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/230a9b31fcf2dad69efb4b337cc3806328f01491.gif[/img]

[h3]Added Resources System[/h3]
[list]
[*] 4 Core Resources Added: Wood, Brick, Stone and Tile
[*] Added resource piles added throughout the world that reset each journey. Resource piles are located near where the resource would be expected (wood in forests, stone near cliffs and boulders, tile and brick near structures)
[*] Added Stockpiles to Evenfall, Seaside Village and Tori-Jin Temple Roost where all resources a traveler is carrying can be deposited. 
[*] Resources deposited at stockpiles can be used to upgrade shops and buildings in the same town.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38168200/631a4a0747ac1bdf0f920f270aece9a7a3f9e457.gif[/img]

[h3]Updated Shop System[/h3]
[list]
[*] All items purchased through shops are now done through a menu accessed via dialogue with the shopkeeper.
[*] Added a new menu for purchasing items and potions at shops
[*] New Shop Types: Item Shops, Potion Shops, Armor Shops and Weapon Shops
[*] Added sales. If an item is on sale, the item is priced at 50% off the shops normal price. Sales are generated at the beginning of every new Journey.
[*] Added shop upgrades. If you have the resources, you can upgrade shops to improve their prices, frequency of sales, inventory slots and more!

This update focuses on improving the user interface, quality of life for several gameplay aspects and replacing the player leveling system with a slot-based item leveling system!

[*] Added the magic gloves item to replace the default mage hands weapon type (Wanderer Default)
[*] When an item levels up it is automatically upgraded to the next tier of that item. For example, when a Level 1 Worn-Out Revolver gains enough experience to level up, it will become a Level 2 Revolver.
[*] Experience points are simultaneously distributed across all gear. For example, if the traveler receives 10 exp, each slot will receive 10 exp.
[*] Added enemy item drops
[*] Added new weapon models for most in-game weapons
[*] The wanderer's class now starts with a "Magic Glove" that has unique VFX for each of it's 5 weapon levels. The glove functions the same as the "fist" weapon type did before.
[*] Changed the melee animations and attacks for various ranged weapons. All weapons now have both ranged and melee attacks and animations.
[*] Expanded internal weapon enumerations and structs to prepare for 30+ unique weapon types in upcoming patches.

[*] The abilities tab allows players to reorder abilities for ability slots 1-4.
[*] Simplified notifications for newly discovered items, monsters and notes.
[*] Updated UI box and border styles for item stats boxes, class selection borders, title screen borders, notification borders, tutorial borders and more.
[*] New Title Screen with a new (preview) text logo
[/list]

[*] Potions dropped by enemies are now automatically added to the traveler's inventory

[*] Updated potion buff particles

The time has come for an update. A big one. We're making progress. And we're getting closer to Early Access every day! Visually we have made some heavy improvements including new VFX and animations across the board. The Eventide Hollow is also growing and changing as we prepare to implement the first dungeons into the game. Finally, the close-range combat system has been completely reworked to be simpler and more fun and engaging.

So, to get a glimpse of what we've been working on, we are excited to announce that we will be participating in the Gamescom Indie Arena Booth Selection and have prepared a playable demo version on Steam for everyone to try out! This demo is of course reduced in content from the main game – but we hope it gives you a taste of some of the changes we are making for the next update to the main game. For our Alpha Testers, we hope to have the update ready in early September to get your feedback!

Looking forward, our next major milestone will be the game’s first dungeon: The Old Mill. Once we have pushed that update out for our Alpha Backers we plan to continue polishing, fixing bugs and adding content. Our current goal is 3 full dungeons completed before Early Access.

As always, I’d like to extend a big thank you to everyone that has supported the project! We are making great progress and are so excited to share more updates with you in the near future. Enjoy the demo!

notes.title: Holomento Alpha 0.4.21
notes.content:
[h3]What's New[/h3]
[list]
[*] Your last played save game is now automatically loaded after playing the game once (unless you delete a save file).
[*] Added an entrance area for the Old Mill Dungeon (Dungeon not yet added)
[*] Potion System Overhaul (see below)
[*] Overhauled the weather system (see below)
[*] Bows have been completely reworked to (see below)
[*] Mushroom enemies now attack when a traveler approaches. Mushroom enemies will fire their projectiles every time they are damaged
[*] New Title Screen with dynamic weather that properly transitions into a run
[*] Added dynamic combat music that changes while in the overworld
[*] Obelisk donation costs now scale with a traveler's money on-hand. The initial obelisk cost is 5% of traveler money + $25 to $50. Each subsequent donation now only increases cost by 5-25% (previously 10-50%)
[*] Added input options to navigate between pages of the Holomento (book) menu
[/list]

[h3]New Potion Menu System[/h3]
The existing potion wheel was buggy and unfinished so it has been replaced with a new linear potion selection system. In the potion menu, an infinite horizontal scrolling menu has been added to access all potion types and an infinite vertical component has been added to change their size. More details of this system are listed below:
[list]
[*] The traveler can now carry an unlimited amount of each potion type and size
[*] New (infinite) linear potion selection menu - horizontal input selects potion type, vertical input selects potion size
[*] Potion buffs are now displayed on the side of the potion menu and main user interface. When the potion menu is open, the name of each buff and time remaining for that buff are shown
[*] Using multiple of the same potion now stacks the effect and increases the duration
[*] New custom inputs for potion selection can be changed in the options menu
[*] Small potions are now less effective and last for a shorter duration
[*] Large potions are now more effective and last longer
[*] Reduced potion spawns for all enemies.
[/list]

[h3]New Weather System[/h3]
The weather system has been completely reworked. Weather is now dynamic and will change every 5 (realtime) minutes. More details on the new system below:
[list]
[*] There are now 4 states of weather: Sunny, Cloudy, Rainy/Snowy and Thunderstorms/Blizzards.
[*] When entering/leaving snowy locations, rain and thunderstorms will automatically (and smoothly) switch to snow storms and blizzards.
[*] Snowy locations now support sunny and cloudy weather.
[*] Clouds have been reworked and will now move slowly across the sky.
[*] Rain and thunderstorms will now never occur in the central valley and desert
[*] The lighting system and skybox have also been tweaked to give certain areas a more cinematic look.
[*] Some locations have color overlay effects (post-processing) that still need tweaked - these should be polished in the next few patches.
[/list]

[h3]Bow Rework[/h3]
Bows have been very similar to a mage's magic fist projectiles since Holomento's inception. The intent of this rework is to make them feel distinct and more like a "sharpshooter" weapon type (focusing on aim precision and high damage single shots). Many aspects of bows have changed to reflect these changes. More details below.
[list]
[*] The "Fire" input can no longer be held for bows - it must be pressed to fire
[*] Bows now have a significantly longer draw time (~ +0.75 seconds)
[*] Dodging while drawing does NOT reset your draw (you can dodge enemies while charging up a shot)
[*] Bows now do significantly more damage (~ +10 on average)
[*] While aiming, the traveler now walks
[*] Aiming zooms in the camera as the bow is drawn
[*] Arrows remain in the air for twice as long as other projectiles (2 seconds vs. 1 second)
[*] Max Fire Rate for Bows has been reduced from 5 shots/sec to 2 shots/sec
[*] Regeneration bar now reflects bow draw percent (full bar means bow is ready to fire)
[*] Bows can only be fired once fully drawn (this may be reworked to allow for quick shots that do less/damage and travel a shorter distance)
[*] Added a visual arrow when bow is being drawn and aimed
[*] Fixed a bug where bows wouldn't fire properly
[*] Fixed a bug where bows would sometimes fire twice
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes and Optimization[/h3]
[list]
[*] Player is now invincible during dialogue.
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera would sometimes clip through snow and sand
[*] Fixed a bug where snow and sand would have odd clipping issues at the edge of the screen
[*] Enemy scaling now scales to dps instead of player level (again).
[*] Fixed several soft-lock spots in Eventide Pass.
[*] Fixed a bug where it would sometimes snow in areas outside the Frigid Fjord.
[*] Fixed a blocked staircase in Frigid Fjord.
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't get to the Travelers guild easily because of broken collision.
[*] Fixed a bug where the current location wouldn't properly show after a run is loaded.
[*] Added new flavortext and holofont for locations. Fixed a bug where location display text was inconsistent.
[*] Fixed a bug where potion buff particles would sometimes stay after a potion buff has ended
[*] Optimized location borders so that locations are much more accurate.
[*] Fixed the end of run locations and items discovered totals to be more accurate. Added percentages.
[*] Fixed a bug where you could sometimes die by clipping with the Eventide Pass Elevator in the corner.
[*] Fixed a bug where you would sometimes be unable to getup from a ragdoll state. Added a failsafe that allows you to getup from ragdoll after 5 seconds
[*] Added a small delay to donating at shrines and obelisks to input prevent spam bugs
[*] Added a small delay to opening/closing the Holomento to input prevent spam bugs
[*] Fixed known loading zone issues on the beach

A developer console has been added for debugging and bug reporting purposes. You can access the console by going to Options->Game Options->Developer Console Enabled and checking the box. You can also bind any key to the console by using the binding labeled "Open Developer Console" below the checkbox. Once the input is bound (default binding is [.]) you can open the console in game at any time. Note that opening the console does NOT pause the game.

[h3] Command List [/h3]

help
Shows the command list.

item | items
Lists all items in the game.

spawn.item <item name>
Spawns an item of [item name] in front of the traveler.

consumable | consumables
Lists all consumables in the game.

spawn.consumable <item name> <amount>
Spawns [amount] of consumable designated by [consumable name].

weather <weather type>
Sets weather to [weather type]. Use without args for usage.

hp <amount>
Adds [amount] of health to the traveler's current health. If unspecified this sets traveler health to max.

xp <amount>
Gives the traveler [amount] of xp. Gives 100xp if [amount] is not specified.

cash | money <amount>
Gives the traveler [amount] of money. Gives $1,000 if [amount] is not specified.

scale <amount>
Sets the traveler scale to the decimal [amount]

scale.x | scale.y | scale.z <amount>
Sets the traveler X | Y | Z scale to the decimal [amount]

die | kill
Instantly kills the player.

notes.title: Alpha 0.2.000
notes.content:
[h1]Alpha Patch 0.2.0 is here! [/h1]

This patch primarily aims to optimize several aspects of the game including loading times, the Title Screen, various locations through the game and the Class Selection menu. These changes also make the world more scale-able for future updates and patches. Several other additions are here including visual upgrades to the Eventide Chateau Dungeon.

A roadmap has been added to the official Holomento website. For the latest information on expectations for future patches please visit: 

[url=https://holomento.com/roadmap/ ]https://holomento.com/roadmap/ [/url]

[b]After installing this update it is HIGHLY RECOMMENDED you start a new run as loading zones will work improperly with legacy runs.[/b]

[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Switching from deferred to forward rendering to increase performance.
[*] Decreased loading times during game start.
[*] Loading screens have been added during run starts and title screen loads.
[*] Asynchronous level loading added with loading zones. Frame rates are increased across the game however, there are now loading zones where the fps will drop as levels are loaded in. This is a known issue and will be addressed in a future patch.
[*] Class Selection now occurs in a different area than where a run starts (performance increase)
[*] Hovering over a class item in the class selection screen now displays that items stats
[*] Title Screen now selects at random one of 11 locations in the world to view and loads ONLY that location while viewing to enhance title screen performance.
[*] Eastern Temple Overhaul - fleshed out area and optimized.
[*] Eventide Chateau - fleshed out area, modified its look and optimized.
[*] Several changes to Eventide Chateau in preparation to make it fully upgradeable.
[*] Added Sultry Spa - a relaxing place where you can fully heal at any time during a run for a small fee.
[*] Added NPC Dialogue animations.
[*] Pressing the pause menu button during dialogue now exits dialogue.
[*] Money is now visible during dialogue. Any money spent or received has an animation to reflect the amount.
[*] Added player health regeneration. This stat is calculated as hp/sec and can be modified with items.
[*] Added an indicator for DPS (damage x attack rate).
[*] Added an indicator for health regeneration (hp/sec).
[*] Wanderer/Mage Class now utilizes the Holomento to attack.
[*] Added enemy spawns to the Eastern Temple Area.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing and Reworks[/h3]
[list]
[*] BASE fire rate changed to 1.42 shot/sec
[*] BASE projectile speed changed to 2.25 m/s
[*] BASE health changed to 25
[*] BASE projectile spread reduced to 2.5 degrees
[*] Elemental BASE Health Increased to 10
[*] Elemental BASE Damage Increased to 3
[*] Mushroom BASE Health Increased to 25
[*] Mushroom BASE Damage Increased to 5
[*] Restoration Ring now increases health regen by 0.05/sec
[*] Heart Trinket now increases health regen by 0.1/sec
[*] Assault Rifle now reduces fire rate by 0.5 (instead of 0.95)
[*] Iron Twinswords now do an extra 3 damage
[*] Iron Twinswords firerate improved by 0.2
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added zone name to Dock Town.
[*] Fixed a bug where unequipping an item wouldn't reset to previous stats
[*] Temporarily removed the bridge npc dialogue as he will just scam money infinitely.
[*] Temporarily disabled enemy spawns in danger zones (enemies appear to spawn under the map)
[*] Various UI Tweaks
[*] Fixed a bug where certain stats wouldn't change between runs.
[*] Fixed a bug where an enemy would spawn inside the Eventide Pass bridge
[*] Fixed a bug where you couldn't attack in Experimental mode
[*] Atmosphere changes are now smoother (they take approximately one second to complete)
[*] Added text outlines to help improve readability.
[*] Switching AA method to temporal for a softer overall look.
[/list]

To submit bugs or request new features, please visit: [url=https://holomento.com/holomento-issue-tracking/]https://holomento.com/holomento-issue-tracking/[/url]

notes.title: Holomento Roadmap and FAQ
notes.content:
[h1]Roadmap[/h1]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dRps2kL.png[/img]

[h1]FAQ[/h1]

[h3]When will the game come out?[/h3]
The current target for Early Access is the first half of 2021. Full release will be within 1 year of the Early Access Release.

[h3]How many people are making this game?[/h3]
Currently, there are three people working on Holomento.
[list]
[*] Sean Weech - Development (Programming, Art, World Design etc.)
[*] Wilfried Nass - Audio Design
[*] Adeel Jafree - Music Composition/Recording
[/list]
Ideally, I will be hiring a character artist for character design and animation in the near future, however we will need more funding before this is possible.

[h3]Will the game have multiplayer?[/h3]
There is no multiplayer planned for Holomento.

[h3]How long have you been working on the game?[/h3]
Development started in January 2020. 

[h3]What platforms will you be releasing for?[/h3]
Currently, the only supported platform is Windows. Linux and Mac are planned but I don't have sufficient hardware to build for these platforms yet. Stay tuned for updates.

[h3]What hardware will you need to run the game?[/h3]
Please see the minimum and recommended hardware requirements on the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/721700/Holomento/]Steam Store Page[/url].

[h3]Will Holomento have voice acting?[/h3]
No. The game will use a gibberish voice system similar to Animal Crossing's Animalese or Undertale's soundfont system.

[h3]Where can I report bugs and/or request features?[/h3]
You can use the official Holomento Issue Tracker found [url=https://holomento.com/holomento-issue-tracking/]here[/url].
